# Mary Vance

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P17](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0017), [v5 c5 P38](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Over-harbour  <sub>[v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087)</sub>
- **Role:** Hired girl and household helper  <sub>[v5 c5 P49](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0049), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mary-creature  <sub>[v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P1](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0001), [v5 c9 P44](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary Vance has bright, strange eyes, a pretty mouth, and even, white teeth. After being taken in and fed, her face grows plump, rosy, and healthy. In her finer dress, she sports crimped hair and clothes such as a blue velvet cap, navy coat, and a squirrel-fur muff. She is also skilled at making grotesque shadow-pictures and funny facial expressions.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c7 P11](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0011), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)_

## Personality

Mary is outspoken, opinionated, bossy, and prone to boasting about her capabilities and past hardships. She possesses a fiery temper and often lectures others on proper conduct and religious ideas, though she herself can be mischievous and slangy. Despite her sharp tongue and dramatic warnings, she has a good heart, works exceptionally hard, and holds deep affection for her friends.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058), [v5 c5 P87](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0087), [v5 c6 P7](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0007), [v5 c6 P9](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0009), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c8 P51](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0051), [v5 c9 P1](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0001), [v5 c9 P48](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0048), [v5 c11 P4](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0004), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c18 P33](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0033), [v5 c23 P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 c33 P1](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0001)_

- To stay in Four Winds with her friends  <sub>[v5 c8 P51](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0051)</sub>
- To prove her worth and avoid being pitying by others  <sub>[v5 c5 P58](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0058)</sub>

## History

Mary Vance ran away from her abusive guardian, Mrs. Wiley, and hid in a barn without food for days until the Meredith children found her and brought her to the manse. Shortly afterward, Mrs. Wiley died, leaving Mary stranded until Mr. Meredith and Una helped arrange for Miss Cornelia Elliott to adopt her. Living with Miss Cornelia, Mary threw herself into household work, transformed into a clean and healthy child, and began attending church and school. She joined the circle of children playing in Rainbow Valley, frequently sharing ghost stories, gossiping, and lecturing her peers on improper behavior. She frequently spread dramatic horror stories about stepmothers to Una and Faith, causing Una great anxiety until the truth was cleared up. Over time, she became an indispensable helper to Miss Cornelia and a deeply cherished, if outspoken, friend to the Glen St. Mary children.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P17](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0017), [v5 c5 P21](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0021), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c6 P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c9 P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 c9 P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 c9 P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080), [v5 c11 P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c23 P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 c23 P84](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0084), [v5 c26 P26](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0026), [v5 c29 P0](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0000), [v5 c34 P30](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0030), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
